latestVersion.changelog:
First release introducing comprehensive First Solar knowledge:

- Covers company history, major milestones, and market position as the largest US solar module producer.
- Explains unique CdTe thin-film technology and contrasts with conventional silicon.
- Details effects of the IRA policy on US solar manufacturing.
- Outlines commercial model, technical advantages, production capacity, and key financials.
- Includes order book data, product efficiency, and summary of their industry-leading recycling program.
- Lists interesting facts highlighting First Solar’s innovation and competitive new energy edge.
